statBlock.name: Gray Slaad (control gem variant)
statBlock.description: A gray slaad can pass for a humanoid and use illusion, flight, and planar travel to choose its fights.

sections.Senses: Blindsight and darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Control Gem. The slaad has a magical gem in its brain. It must obey the creature that possesses the gem and is immune to being Charmed for as long as the gem controls it. Destroying the gem ends this means of control.
Spell extraction. If the slaad fails a save against Imprisonment, the caster can have the spell move the gem to their open hand instead of imprisoning the slaad. Wish can retrieve the gem if cast in the slaad's presence with that wording. Greater Restoration cast on the slaad destroys the gem without injuring it.
Surgical extraction. A creature proficient in Wisdom (Medicine) can remove the gem while the slaad is Incapacitated. Each attempt takes 1 minute of uninterrupted work and a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage to the slaad.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 14. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
2/day each. Fear, Fly, Fireball, Tongues.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw or Greatsword attacks.
Bite (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

ruleNotes: The Spawning Stone implants a color-matched gem in each slaad it creates. A slaad born elsewhere gains a gem only if it touches the Stone.
The printed Multiattack includes a Bite, which is available only in slaad form. In humanoid form, use the listed individual weapon attack unless another printed Multiattack option is available.

statBlock.name: Gas Spore
statBlock.description: This floating fungus resembles a beholder from a distance. Its hollow body releases infectious spores when it bursts.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft. It is blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When reduced to 0 HP, the gas spore explodes. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and contracts the disease below. A creature immune to being Poisoned cannot contract it.
Spore disease. Roll 1d12 and add the infected creature's Constitution score. That is the number of hours before the disease kills it, unless removed. Halfway through, the creature becomes Poisoned for the remaining time. After it dies, 2d4 Tiny gas spores sprout from its corpse and reach full size in 7 days.
Eerie Resemblance. A creature that can see the gas spore identifies it as a fungus with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) check.
sections.Actions: Touch. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 1 poison damage. The target contracts the spore disease unless it succeeds on a DC 10 Constitution save or is immune to being Poisoned.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 138 (stat block), p. 137 (beholder memories).

ruleNotes: A creature that survives inhaling spores released by a gas spore grown from a beholder corpse can inherit fragments of the dead beholder's memories. Use them for clues about its former lair and nearby creatures or locations.

statBlock.name: Gray Ooze (Psychic)
statBlock.description: A mature gray ooze can develop enough intelligence to attack another creature's mind.

sections.Variant: Uses the Gray Ooze base profile with Intelligence 6 and the additional Psychic Crush action.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The ooze can pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Corrode Metal. After a hit from a nonmagical metal weapon, that weapon permanently loses 1 from its damage rolls. Penalties stack and destroy it at −5. Nonmagical metal ammunition is destroyed after it hits and deals damage. The ooze can eat through 2 inches of nonmagical metal in one round.
False Appearance. A motionless ooze looks like an oily puddle or wet rock.
Ooze Nature. It needs no sleep.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. Nonmagical metal armor worn by the target takes a permanent, stacking −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor breaks once its AC drops to 10.
Psychic Crush (recharge 5–6). Choose one creature it senses within 60 ft. The creature makes a DC 10 Intelligence save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on failure or half on success.
